fields.headline: Chronic insomnia: what actually helps
fields.summary: Why sleeping tablets are no longer first-line treatment, and what a course of CBT-I involves week by week.

media.alt: Person sitting quietly under a tree in a forest

aspects.text: Trouble falling asleep three or more nights a week, for three months or longer
Waking in the early hours and being unable to get back to sleep
Shift work, chronic pain, anxiety, late caffeine
Cognitive behavioural therapy for insomnia (CBT-I), 6–8 weeks
